specs.name: CPU
specs.value: Raspberry Pi® CM5/CM5Lite; BCM2712 Quad(4) Core Cortex-A76 at 2.4GHz

specs.name: Storage
specs.value: Internal M.2 NVMe connector for SSD card (optional)

specs.name: Display
specs.value: 10.1” IPS LCD, 1280 x 800 px, brightness 400 cd/m2

specs.name: USB
specs.value: 2 x USB 3.0 type-A Host, 1 x USB type-C OTG

specs.name: PCIe
specs.value: M.2 2230/2242 M-key, PCIe Gen 2.0 x 1(5Gbps) (PCIe Gen 3.0 x1 is compatible but experimental) (optional)

specs.name: RTC
specs.value: High accuracy RTC with farad capacitor, can work 1 week after power off (default). High accuracy RTC with lithium coin battery, can work 3 years after power off (optional).

specs.name: GPIO/Wiegand
specs.value: (Optional) 2 x 5V Logic GPIO Outputs, can be used as Wiegand signal

specs.name: Micro SD card socket
specs.value: 1 x TF(micro SD) card slot, only for CM5 Lite module to boot from TF

specs.name: Relay
specs.value: 1 x relay with “Normally Connected” and “Normally Open” output

specs.name: RS485
specs.value: Default 1 x RS485; up to 2 x RS485 (optional)

specs.name: CAN
specs.value: Default 0 x CAN; Optional 1 x CAN FD BUS. Arbitration Bit Rate up to 1Mbps, Data Bit Rate up to 8Mbps

specs.name: 3G/4G/LTE/GPS
specs.value: Internal 4G/LTE module supported, not mounted by default
